title: Replace the NBA-only root redirect with a neutral multi-domain portal
current_repo_state: Root index.html is a meta-refresh that sends every visitor to docs/assurance/, an NBA-only dashboard.
decision_problem_solved: A decision-maker opening the live root never sees the NFL or SF-94122 work and may mistake the NBA '0 observations' cards for the state of the whole project.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: neutral root selector (NBA | NFL | SF 94122). Path B: keep the redirect and add a global domain switcher. Path C: split into one repository per domain.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Sign-off after the concurrent Arena sessions stop merging, so the root file has no conflict.

title: Name one canonical NFL pack and archive the others
current_repo_state: docs/nfl/, docs/nfl-3b81013c/, docs/nfl-origination/ and now docs/nfl-309921cc/ each answer overlapping questions with different evidence standards.
decision_problem_solved: A reviewer can act on an older or less complete checklist without realising a newer one exists.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: keep all, add an 'Archived provenance' banner and a canonical pointer. Path B: merge the best tables into one hub. Path C: delete the superseded packs.
recommended_path: Path A now, Path B later; never Path C while each pack holds its own source register.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Compare flagged-item coverage and strictness across the four packs first.

title: Repoint every citation of the dead nfl.com/official-nfl-rules/ URL
current_repo_state: 71 rows across 20+ files, including live published pages, cite that URL; it returned the official NFL 404 page on 2026-11-13.
decision_problem_solved: A row whose supporting link is a 404 cannot be treated as verified, yet it is currently presented as sourced.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: repoint all to operations.nfl.com/rules-officiating/2026-nfl-rulebook. Path B: repoint to the specific rule section each row relies on. Path C: leave and mark unverified.
recommended_path: Path B where the specific section is known, otherwise Path A.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Owner edit of data/nfl/sources.csv and a rebuild of docs/nfl/.
effort_and_reversibility: Medium - touches another session's files, so log the request first

title: Correct the live URLs printed in the README
current_repo_state: The README publishes https://sassnarep3-star.github.io/Own6/nfl/, which returns GitHub's 404; Pages is served from main:/ so the live path is /docs/nfl/.
decision_problem_solved: The first link a reader follows from the repository is dead.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: edit the README. Path B: add a redirect page at docs/nfl-legacy/. Path C: change the Pages source.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Owner edit; no other file needs to change.

title: Stamp every official capture with a UTC timestamp and a content hash
current_repo_state: Captures are dated by session day only; nothing records what the page looked like at capture time.
decision_problem_solved: Two packs captured hours apart can disagree, and there is no way to tell which reflects the newer page.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: write a SHA-256 of the parsed table to a metadata file per capture. Path B: store the raw parsed text. Path C: rely on the session date.
recommended_path: Path A, with Path B for the injury report because designations change intraday.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Decide a capture cadence (the injury report changes three times a week).
effort_and_reversibility: Medium - reversible, but must be applied to new captures only

title: Either lag all inputs to the standings snapshot or wait for the refresh
current_repo_state: The standings table read on 2026-11-13 does not yet include the completed Thursday 12 November game.
decision_problem_solved: Mixing a standings-derived rate with a result the standings do not contain silently double-counts or omits a game.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: refuse to model any game already played. Path B: adjust the standings by hand. Path C: ignore the discrepancy.
recommended_path: Path A - reject already-played games at build time.
prerequisites_before_implementing: A build-time check comparing the standings snapshot date with the slate dates.

title: Show the club's own 'unofficial' caveat on every depth-derived row
current_repo_state: Both captured charts state they are unofficial and reflect writers' opinions, not the organisation's.
decision_problem_solved: A reader can read '2nd string will replace the starter' as an official fact when the source explicitly disclaims it.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: carry the caveat text into the row. Path B: a page-level banner only. Path C: drop depth charts entirely.
recommended_path: Path A - caveat on the row, banner on the page.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Nothing; already implemented in this pack.

title: Label proposed thresholds and measured values differently, everywhere
current_repo_state: Elsewhere in the repo, expected signs, minimum-sample floors and depth thresholds are published in value columns without saying they are design choices.
decision_problem_solved: A proposed threshold in a value column reads like an observed measurement.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: a required 'value_kind' column on every table. Path B: a page-level legend. Path C: leave as is.
recommended_path: Path A - every row states measured, model output, proposed, or unverified.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Nothing; already implemented in this pack.

title: Split COORDINATION.md into a task board and an append-only archive
current_repo_state: COORDINATION.md is roughly 194 KB of append-only session history, with the live task board buried above it.
decision_problem_solved: A session claiming a task must read a very large file to find out what is already claimed, which raises the chance of duplicate work.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: keep COORDINATION.md as the board and move history to COORDINATION_HISTORY.md. Path B: one file per session in a directory. Path C: leave as is.
recommended_path: Path A - board stays at the top of COORDINATION.md; older sections move to an archive file.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Every active session must agree to the split before it happens.
effort_and_reversibility: Low - reversible, but it is a shared file

title: Stop concurrent branches editing the same derived inventories
current_repo_state: Open PR #68 and PR #72 both modify data/assurance/*, data/source_coverage/* and audit/SOURCE_COVERAGE.md, which are regenerated build outputs.
decision_problem_solved: Every integration session must resolve the same conflicts in generated files, and a stale hash can fail CI for unrelated reasons.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: mark generated inventories as build artifacts and exclude them from PR diffs. Path B: regenerate only in the final integration run. Path C: leave as is.
recommended_path: Path B - regenerate derived inventories only in the final integration, never in a feature branch.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Agreement from the owners of the two open PRs.

title: Publish a single 'what we cannot show' table per domain
current_repo_state: Each pack has its own flagged page; a reader must open four pages to learn what is missing.
decision_problem_solved: The most important content - what is unknown - is the hardest to find.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: one consolidated evidence-gap page per domain. Path B: keep per-pack flagged pages. Path C: a machine-readable gaps file.
recommended_path: Path C plus Path A - a gaps CSV rendered as one page.

title: Put the rights question first, before any further numeric capture
current_repo_state: The NFL.com terms prohibit systematic retrieval to compile a database without written consent; this repository is, by construction, a compiled database of official NFL tables.
decision_problem_solved: Continuing to add official tables increases exposure while the question is unanswered.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: pause numeric capture pending counsel. Path B: keep capturing but reduce to what a human reader could verify in one page view. Path C: continue unchanged.
recommended_path: Path A for the decision, Path B as an interim operating rule.
effort_and_reversibility: High impact if adopted - reversible only by deleting captured data

title: Make the source-link checker also probe for HTTP errors, not just shape
current_repo_state: Existing checkers validate that a row has an https link and that internal links resolve; they do not fetch the link.
decision_problem_solved: A 404 in a source column passes every current check, which is how 71 dead citations survived to publication.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: a nightly workflow that HEADs every distinct source URL. Path B: check links at build time. Path C: manual review.
recommended_path: Path A - nightly HEAD check with a per-URL pass/fail table.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Agreement on which workflow owns it, to avoid duplicate CI.

title: Keep rewards non-monetary and say so on the page
current_repo_state: The four-tier ladder awards publication priority and research standing only.
decision_problem_solved: Any hint of a prize would conflict with the non-commercial-use restriction in the terms.
option_paths_for_review: Path A: keep non-monetary and label it. Path B: offer a monetary prize. Path C: remove the ladder.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Nothing; already stated on the leaderboard page.
